semantics.raw_candidate: All matched listings are evaluated with fixed ranges plus 10 km, with the whole-taxon infraspecific exception on. No per-species ship-rule drops or allowlist selection have been applied to this candidate.
semantics.comparison: Methods operate only on test listings. Identified infraspecific taxa are labeled from the frozen test set, and clipping is scored with the infraspecific exception off to avoid leakage.
semantics.selected_production_test_listing_rule: Species classified COVERS and badger, shrike and bison count everywhere; SPILLS and Silene scouleri test listings count nowhere. Matching fixes remain required.
semantics.production_evidence_boundary: Candidate logs do not verify production. Selected production metrics are proved separately by the embedded independent whole-layer reconstruction report; candidate cell, rank and loss metrics remain distinct.
semantics.sensitivity_status: No-overrides and without-UNCLEAR values are reported sensitivities and do not replace the fixed 3a ship decision.
semantics.supplemental_metric_status: Listing-specific pair correction is reporting only. It has no role in ship selection.
semantics.selected_production_non_test_listing_rul: Retained listings count at species level except the connected-key polygon safeguards 58, 96 and 418, which use their individual buffered polygons with the infraspecific exception disabled.
